app.name: Singline
tray.sleepAtEnd: Sleep timer – at the end of the song
settings.showInDockHint: Keeps Singline in the Dock and the app switcher, for a menu bar too full to show its icon. A click on it opens the settings.
settings.lyricsOnlyHint: No song, buttons, microphone or timeline, not even under the pointer.
settings.clickThroughHint: Clicks go through the lyrics to the window behind them. Turn it off in Singline's menu, or open Singline again.
status.idleAutomatic: Play a song in Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music or YouTube Music.
status.permission: Allow access to {player} in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation.
status.noTrackData: {player} does not report this song. Play it from your library.
status.readFailed: {player} could not be read right now.
status.noPosition: {player} does not report the playback position, so the lyrics cannot follow.
lyrics.notFound: No synced lyrics found for this song.
lyrics.offline: Offline. Your own lyrics stay available.
lyrics.failed: Lyrics could not be loaded right now.
lyrics.rateLimited: LRCLIB is busy. Try again in a moment.
karaoke.title: Singline – Karaoke
settings.title: Singline – Settings
settings.songSubtitle: Line up the lyrics with the music.
settings.aboutSubtitle: Synced lyrics above your other windows.
layout.caption: One line
settings.karaokeScaleHint: Karaoke fits the lyrics to its screen; this makes them larger or smaller. Open karaoke from the tray menu.
settings.hotkeyHint: Show or hide the overlay, or leave karaoke.
settings.hotkeyError: {hotkey} is already used by another app. Show or hide the overlay from the tray menu instead.
settings.hotkeyChange: Click, then press the new shortcut
settings.hotkeyRecording: Press the new shortcut. Esc cancels.
settings.hotkeyUnsupported: This key cannot be part of a shortcut.
settings.hotkeyTaken: {hotkey} is already used by another app. {previous} still works.
settings.autoHideHint: The overlay disappears 3 seconds after the music stops and comes back when it plays. If you hide it yourself, it stays hidden.
settings.launchAtLoginHint: Start Singline when you log in.
settings.languageHint: Language of the overlay, menu and settings.
settings.includeOtherHint: Browsers, VLC and more, when the source is Automatic.
settings.includeOtherListHint: Browsers, VLC and more, when the source is Automatic. Switch off a player below that Singline should never follow.
settings.later: Show the lyrics a quarter second later
settings.earlier: Show the lyrics a quarter second earlier
settings.noTrack: Play a song to adjust its timing.
settings.offsetHint: Positive values show the lyrics earlier. The global and the per-song correction add up.
settings.privacy: Online search sends title, artist, album and duration to LRCLIB. Your own lyrics stay on this device.
ownLyrics.title: Your own lyrics
ownLyrics.hint: Write lyrics with timestamps or import an LRC file. They take priority over LRCLIB and stay on this device.
ownLyrics.activeHint: This song shows your own lyrics.
ownLyrics.noTrack: Play a song to give it your own lyrics.
ownLyrics.fileTooLarge: Choose an LRC file of at most 512 KB.
ownLyrics.notText: Choose an LRC file saved as UTF-8.
ownLyrics.noTimestamps: The file could not be imported. Check that it has at least one lyric line with an LRC timestamp.
ownLyrics.unreadable: The LRC file could not be read.
ownLyrics.importFailed: The LRC file could not be saved.
ownLyrics.saveFailed: Your lyrics could not be saved.
ownLyrics.removeFailed: Your lyrics could not be removed.
ownLyrics.editFailed: The editor could not be opened.
editor.title: Singline – Edit lyrics
editor.heading: Edit your own lyrics
editor.hint: Paste your lyrics, then press {shortcut} while the song plays to stamp the line at the cursor. The cursor then moves to the next line.
editor.stampHelp: Sets the timestamp and moves to the next line ({shortcut})
editor.missingTimestamp: At least one line needs a timestamp.
editor.otherTrack: “{title}” is not playing right now. Play it to set timestamps.
editor.noPosition: The player does not report the playback position, so no timestamp can be set.
editor.notALine: Put the cursor on a lyric line.
editor.stampFailed: The timestamp could not be set right now.
stats.title: Singline – Your music
stats.heading: Your music
stats.subtitle: What you listened to while Singline was running.
stats.empty: No listening history yet. Play some music while Singline is running, and it shows up here.
stats.tileStreakDetail: Days in a row with music
history.keepHint: Stored only on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
about.privacy: Singline needs no account. To find lyrics, it sends a song's title, artist, album and duration to LRCLIB, and keeps what it finds on this device.
about.reportHint: Opens a pre-filled issue on GitHub with the version, your system and the last lines of the log. You see everything before you send it.
about.logHint: What Singline did in the last sessions, kept on this device.
bridge.title: Browser extension
bridge.hint: Lyrics for YouTube, YouTube Music and other web players, also in a background tab. Enter this code once in the Singline extension to pair it.
bridge.unavailable: The extension cannot connect right now because another app uses its port. Singline tries again shortly.
spotify.title: Spotify
spotify.subtitle: Connect your own Spotify app for ♥, your top lists and True Shuffle.
spotify.clientIdHint: A Client ID has 32 characters: digits and the letters a to f.
spotify.waiting: Log in to Spotify in your browser…
spotify.waitingHint: If Spotify shows “Invalid redirect URI”, add the redirect URI above to your app, save, and connect again.
spotify.memoryOnly: This computer has no credential store, so Singline stays connected only until you quit it.
spotify.reconnectHint: Reconnect once so Singline may use everything True Shuffle needs.
spotify.problem.portInUse: Another app uses the login port. Close it and try again.
spotify.problem.browser: No browser opened. Copy the login link and open it in your browser.
spotify.problem.timedOut: The browser did not come back in time. Try again.
spotify.problem.offline: Spotify could not be reached. Check your internet connection.
spotify.problem.expired: The Spotify login expired. Connect again.
spotify.problem.forbidden: Spotify refused the request. Your account needs Premium, and the Client ID must belong to an app you created.
spotify.guideTitle: How to get a Client ID
spotify.guideStep1: Open the Spotify developer dashboard and log in.
spotify.guideStep2: Create an app with any name and select “Web API”.
spotify.guideStep3: Add the redirect URI above and save.
spotify.guideStep4: Copy the app's Client ID here and press Connect Spotify.
spotify.premiumNote: Your Spotify account needs Premium. Spotify lets an app in development mode serve at most five users, so everyone uses an app of their own.
spotify.topHint: Spotify's own ranking. Click one to open it in Spotify.
spotify.topEmpty: Spotify has no ranking for this time yet.
spotify.topError: The top lists could not be loaded.
spotify.page.connectedText: You can close this tab and go back to Singline.
spotify.page.deniedText: The login was cancelled. You can close this tab.
spotify.page.failedText: Spotify reported a problem. Close this tab and try again in Singline.
spotify.page.outdatedText: Go back to Singline and press Connect Spotify again.
shuffle.title: True Shuffle
shuffle.subtitle: An honest random order: no song repeats before every song of the source has played.
shuffle.connectHint: Connect Spotify in Settings to use True Shuffle.
shuffle.keepPlayingHint: Adds the next round before the order runs out.
shuffle.playlistDescription: True Shuffle by Singline. Rewritten on every shuffle, so please don't edit it.
shuffle.notice.empty: This source has no tracks to shuffle.
shuffle.notice.full: Singline Shuffle is full. Shuffle & play starts it fresh.
shuffle.notice.noDevice: Spotify did not show up on this computer. Open Spotify and press Shuffle & play again.
shuffle.notice.auth: The Spotify login expired. Connect again in Settings.
shuffle.notice.offline: Spotify could not be reached. Check your internet connection.
shuffle.notice.premium: Spotify refused the request. Your account needs Premium.
overlay.sing: Sing to find: sing a line, and Singline finds the song
sing.downloadingHint: Only this once. It stays on this computer.
sing.notFound: No song found for these words.
sing.problem.unavailable: This build of Singline cannot recognise singing.
sing.problem.processor: This computer's processor is too old for Sing to find: it lacks AVX2. Everything else in Singline works as usual.
sing.problem.noToken: To find songs you have not heard yet, Sing to find needs a Genius token. Add one in Settings → General.
sing.problem.unauthorized: Genius refused the token. Check it in Settings → General.
sing.problem.onlineOff: Sing to find needs online search. Turn on Search lyrics online in Settings → Song & timing.
sing.problem.offline: No internet connection. Sing to find needs it to look up the song.
sing.problem.rateLimited: Genius is busy. Try again in a moment.
sing.problem.noMicrophone: No microphone found. Connect one and try again.
sing.problem.busy: Another app is using the microphone. Close it and try again.
sing.problem.denied.macos: Singline may not use the microphone. Allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, then try again.
sing.problem.denied.windows: Singline may not use the microphone. Turn on Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone → Let desktop apps access your microphone, then try again.
sing.problem.denied.linux: Singline may not use the microphone. Check that your user may record sound, then try again.
sing.problem.silent.macos: No sound arrives from the microphone. Allow Singline in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, then try again.
sing.problem.silent.windows: No sound arrives from the microphone. Check that it is not muted and that desktop apps may use it in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone.
sing.problem.silent.linux: No sound arrives from the microphone. Check that it is not muted and chosen as the input in the sound settings.
sing.problem.model: The speech recognition could not start. Download the speech model again in Settings → General.
sing.title: Sing to find
sing.hint: Sing a few words: Singline finds the song, shows its lyrics from the line you sang and follows you.
sing.tokenBuiltIn: Singline brings a token of its own. Enter yours to use it instead.
sing.tokenNeeded: Songs you heard are found right on this computer. For any other song, Singline asks Genius, which needs a free token.
sing.guideTitle: How to get a Genius token
sing.guideStep1: Open Genius API Clients and log in, or sign up for free.
sing.guideStep2: Create an API client with any name and website URL.
sing.guideStep3: Click “Generate Access Token” and paste the Client Access Token here.
sing.modelHint: {name}, about 150 MB. Understands many languages and runs on this computer.
sing.modelMissing: Not downloaded yet. Singline downloads it the first time you sing.
sing.privacy: Your voice never leaves this computer: Whisper turns it into text right here, and songs you heard are found here too. For other songs, only the words it heard go to Genius to find the song, and the song's title and artist to LRCLIB for the lyrics.
welcome.title: Welcome to Singline
welcome.tagline: Synced lyrics above your other windows, for whatever you play.
welcome.whereMac: Singline lives in the menu bar, next to the clock. Click its icon for the player and more.
welcome.whereWindows: Singline lives in the notification area of the taskbar. If you don’t see it, click ⌃ next to the clock.
welcome.whereLinux: Singline lives in the tray of your panel. Click its icon for the menu.
welcome.reopen: Lost it? Open Singline again, and the settings appear.
welcome.playerHint: Singline follows it and shows its lyrics. You can change this later in the settings.
welcome.statusDenied: macOS does not let Singline read {player} yet.
welcome.statusAsk: Play a song in {player}. macOS then asks whether Singline may control {player}: click OK.
welcome.statusPlay: Play a song in {player} to try it out.
welcome.statusPlayAny: Play a song in any player to try it out.
welcome.statusBrowser: {player} plays in the browser: pair the Singline extension in the next step.
welcome.browserHint: For YouTube Music, Amazon Music and other web players, install the Singline extension and enter this code in it.
welcome.readyHint: Singline shows the lyrics as soon as a song plays.
welcome.tipControls: Move the pointer over the lyrics for the controls, and drag them wherever you like.
welcome.tipLyricsOnly: Nothing but the lyrics? Turn on Lyrics only in Singline’s menu.
welcome.tipClickThrough: In the way? Click-through turns the lyrics into a ghost you can click through.
welcome.tipSing: Don’t know the song? Sing it: Sing to find in Singline’s menu.
sing.offHint: Off: no microphone in the overlay and no Sing to find in the menus.
sing.listenHint: Or click the microphone in the overlay, then sing a line.
